summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with numpy and torch.nn.functional imports and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with binary 2D and empty-class tests. Nothing was run, so tests and the spec's numeric checks are unverified; hand-checked math matches the spec (batch-of-two case gives TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss about 0.333). Extra choices: the distance matrix and alpha weights are cast to the probability dtype as well as moved to its device. No commit was made.
